blind.description: A 3D model of a classic hand garden trowel. It consists of a turned, rounded wooden handle with a contoured grip, connected via a short metallic neck/ferrule to a scooped, pointed triangular metal blade with beveled edges. The model is clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, broken, or melted parts, resting horizontally flat on the ground.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a horizontal hand tool with a bulbous wooden handle on the left, a thin metal neck, and a pointed, scoop-shaped blade pointing to the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely small compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure; roughly 10 to 12 inches long, lying flat on the ground with a height of only a few inches.
